id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: Name of the asset hierarchy template and the root asset's hierarchy id from this template.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

displayName.description: Translated {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate#name}, to be used in the UI.

assetHierarchyTemplateAssetIdToFieldValu.description:
An optional field that maps {@link ReliabilityAsset} names to a group of fields. Determines what fields will initially be set on creation.
Proper format of this json should be {hierarchyTemplateAssetId: {field: value}}.

Note: 'root' is a reserved word that cannot be used in this property.

childToParentMap.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAsset#hierarchyTemplateAssetId}s of all the non root assets in this template mapped to their parent {@link ReliabilityAsset#hierarchyTemplateAssetId}s.
Each asset {@link ReliabilityAsset#hierarchyTemplateAssetId}s in this {@link Map} must be mapped to a valid parent.

This field holds the hierarchical structure used in {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate#addAssetsFromHierarchy} to
create and connect {@link ReliabilityAsset} entities.

Note: 'root' is a reserved word for the map. It can only be used as a value.

title: The type stores a template of pre-associated subsystem assets.
name: AssetHierarchyTemplate
